title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
statement: Given an integer array, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
The subsequence does not need to be contiguous, but element order must be preserved.

followUpDirections.direction: Ask the candidate to restate the inputs, outputs, constraints, and ambiguities.
